CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 01 / 14

Competitive firm and output choice

Competitive assumptions競爭市場假設

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify a competitive market's assumptions: many buyers and sellers, identical products and price-taking behavior; understand free entry and exit as the long-run model assumption.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

許多買賣雙方交易同質產品，個別企業無法自行影響市價。自由進出是長期假設，使利潤吸引進入或虧損引致退出。

Many buyers and sellers trade identical products, so an individual firm takes the market price as given. Free entry and exit is a long-run assumption that permits industry adjustment when profits change.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：One small wheat farmer cannot raise the market wheat price by choosing a personal price. 新企業能進入時，長期正利潤會吸引供給。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A price-taking firm faces which demand for its output? 價格接受者面對的個別需求？
